concerns.text: FR‑004 requires Nested Cross‑Validation (default) on the training set. The listed training tasks (T018, T019) only mention GridSearchCV with 5‑fold CV and do not implement the outer‑loop nesting or the conditional hold‑out split for < 50 rows, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

SC‑001 mandates that the regression models achieve R² > 0.0 versus a mean‑predictor baseline. T018.1 creates a mean‑predictor baseline but no subsequent task asserts or checks that the RF/GB models exceed this threshold, so the acceptance criterion is missing.

SC‑002 requires verification that the `size_mismatch` coefficient is statistically significant (p < 0.05) and that its 95 % CI does not include zero. T020 extracts the coefficient and writes it to JSON but does not include a verification step that enforces the significance condition.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – Baseline Calculation (Supporting FR‑006 & FR‑008) – T030
concerns.text: FR‑008 specifies that the baseline calculation script must reside at `code/processing/baseline.py`. The task implements the script at `code/validation/baseline.py`, breaking traceability and violating the spec’s location requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – Baseline Calculation (Supporting FR‑006 & FR‑008) – T030.0
concerns.text: Similarly, T030.0 places a baseline‑fetch script in `code/data/baseline_fetch.py` instead of the mandated `code/processing/baseline.py`, further diverging from the specification.

FR‑001 requires the Data Availability Check to halt with the exact error message: "ERROR: No verified real dataset found. Synthetic data is not permitted for this research goal." T062’s verification description does not explicitly state that this exact message will be used, risking a weakening of the functional requirement.
